displayedInputs.question:
A cube's net is described as follows: the middle row contains 4 small squares labeled 1, 2, 3, and 4 from left to right. The square labeled 5 directly adjoins the top edge of “2,” and the square labeled 6 directly adjoins the bottom edge of “4.” After folding it into a cube, what number is on the face opposite the face labeled 2?

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

What solid is formed when a right triangle is rotated through one full revolution about one of its legs?

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

How many vertices, edges, and faces does a rectangular prism have? (Answer in order, separated by commas.)

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)
Which of the following phenomena illustrates that “a moving surface generates a solid”?

choices.A:
Rotating a right triangle through one full revolution about a leg forms a cone

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)
choices.B:
A car's windshield wiper sweeps out a sector-shaped region on the windshield

[Figure 2](attached-image-5)
choices.C:
A meteor leaves a bright line as it crosses the night sky

[Figure 3](attached-image-6)
choices.D:
A pen tip draws a curve on paper

[Figure 4](attached-image-7)

displayedInputs.question:
A rectangle has a length of 4 cm and a width of 3 cm. It is rotated through one full revolution about the line containing its longer side to form a cylinder. Taking \(\pi=3.14\), what is the volume of this cylinder in \(\mathrm{cm}^3\)? (Round the result to two decimal places.)

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)

Which point is the vertex of \(\angle AOB\)?

[Figure 1](attached-image-9)

4 rays, OA, OB, OC, and OD, extend from point O in this order, and \(\angle AOD\) is less than a straight angle. How many angles less than a straight angle are there in the figure?

[Figure 1](attached-image-10)

Two lines intersect, and \(\angle 1=50^\circ\). What is the measure of the vertical angle of \(\angle 1\)? (Unit: degrees; enter only the numerical value.)

[Figure 1](attached-image-11)
